_comment: The stagings (hpm) a map shows, as the capture of the whole guided tutorial plays them
(Managers.MapStagings). The ones a reply plays are its «stagings» in content/npcs/dialogues.json,
and the ones around a line said without a click, its push's «stagingsBefore» and «stagings».
arrivals  { map, stagings, breed?, criterion? }  shown played out (hpm f1 100) to whoever
enters the map, after its actors; «breed» adds the character's breed number, the
staging of his god's statue (the capture's 11, a Sacrier's; 2 raises Osamodas' beast);
«criterion» (Managers.PlayerCriteria: Qo> done, Qa= under way, Qf= finished) for one
standing only once the quest has got that far
elements  { map, element, stagings }     played from the start on using that element (iwo)
THE GUIDED TUTORIAL. On waking, his god's statue stands raised (his breed). «Desplazarte.»
plays 902; the three steps 912, then the voice's line on the god, then 302; «Ver cómo se
materializa un camino» 901 and 102, the path off the island. Ganymed's room stands with 102 and
910 played out, the gobballs' with 104, the fight room with 108; Ganymed plays 904 on sending
the character to the Celestial Puch, 909 on handing over the gear, 106 on sending him to Master
Hoboulo; Master Hoboulo 908 on sending him to the resources and 108 on sending him on to the
fight room. The five resources of the jobs room play 9071-9075 as they are picked. A path already
built stands built when the room is entered again: the criteria below, not in the capture,
which only walks each room once.
